data.name: Beguiling Touch
data.description: You can charm a living creature by touching it. Creatures with more than %1 Hit Dice are unaffected, as are creatures in combat and those with an attitude of hostile toward you. Creatures receive a Will save DC %2 to negate the effect. Creatures that fail their save are affected by charm monster for %3 rounds. This is a mind-affecting effect. You can use this ability a %4 per day.|ManipulatorBeguilingTouchHD|ManipulatorBeguilingTouchDC|ManipulatorBeguilingTouchRounds|ManipulatorBeguilingTouchTimes
